privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.heroDescription: {{brand}} is designed with your emotional safety and data privacy at its core. We collect only what is necessary to provide you a meaningful experience.

sections.title: What We Collect
body: We collect information you voluntarily provide, including:
We do not collect your real name, phone contacts, location, or any data from outside this app unless you explicitly provide it.
bullets: Journal entries and check-in data
Emotional state and mood information
Message drafts and communication patterns
Profile preferences and settings
Anonymous usage analytics

sections.title: How We Protect Your Data
body: All personal data is stored locally on your device by default. If cloud sync is enabled, data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
bullets: End-to-end encryption for synced data
No third-party advertising or data selling
Optional biometric lock for app access
Anonymous community posting by default

sections.title: AI Processing
body: When you use AI-powered features (companion chat, message analysis, insights), your input is processed by our AI systems to generate responses.
bullets: AI conversations are not used to train models
Processing is done securely with encrypted connections
You can delete AI conversation history at any time
AI memory can be cleared from your profile settings

sections.title: Data Deletion
body: You have the right to delete your data at any time. You can:
Full data deletion can be requested through the app's Settings or by contacting support. Deletion is processed within 30 days.
bullets: Delete individual entries (journals, messages, etc.)
Clear AI companion memory
Request full account and data deletion
Export your data before deletion

sections.title: Contact Us
body: If you have questions about this privacy policy or your data, please reach out:
We aim to respond to all privacy inquiries within 48 hours.

privacy.footer: By using {{brand}}, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. We may update this policy from time to time and will notify you of significant changes.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.heroDescription: Please read these terms carefully. By using {{brand}}, you agree to be bound by these terms.

sections.title: Acceptance of Terms
body: By downloading, installing, or using {{brand}} ("the App"), you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the App.
You must be at least 16 years of age to use this App. If you are under 18, you should have a parent or guardian review these terms with you.

sections.title: Nature of the App
sections.warning: {{brand}} is a self-help companion tool. It is not a substitute for professional mental health treatment, therapy, or medical advice.
body: The App provides tools for emotional awareness, journaling, communication support, and self-reflection. Content generated by AI features is for informational and reflective purposes only.
If you are in crisis or experiencing a mental health emergency, please contact local emergency services or a crisis support line in your country immediately.

sections.title: User Accounts & Data
body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account. All data you enter into the App (journal entries, messages, check-ins) is your personal data.
bullets: You retain ownership of your content
We store data as described in our Privacy Policy
You may request data deletion at any time
We will not share your personal data with third parties for advertising

sections.title: Subscriptions & Payments
sections.label: In-App Purchases
body: BPD Companion requires an active membership. Subscriptions are billed through your App Store or Google Play account.
bullets: Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
You can manage subscriptions in your device settings
Refunds are handled by Apple/Google per their policies
Free features including crisis support remain always accessible

sections.title: Acceptable Use
body: You agree not to:
bullets: Use the App to harm, threaten, or harass others
Post harmful, abusive, or illegal content in community features
Attempt to reverse-engineer or exploit the App
Use AI features to generate harmful content
Share your account credentials with others

sections.title: Community Guidelines
body: Community features are designed for peer support. All community interactions must be respectful, supportive, and constructive.
We reserve the right to remove content or suspend accounts that violate these guidelines.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
sections.label: Legal Disclaimer
body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any decisions made based on App content, AI-generated suggestions, or community interactions.
To the maximum extent permitted by law, we shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App.

sections.title: Changes to Terms
body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms. We will notify you of significant changes through the App.

sections.title: Contact
body: For questions about these terms:
